summary: Re-lay out root AGENTS.md, scripts/e2e/README.md and docs/kubernetes.md with INFRA-631's checker (semantic line breaks, blank lines between items, failing tables and hand-written enumerations to lists, the Commands fences to lists, oversized items split), regenerated by .legion/INFRA-632/restructure.ts; add the checker's verbatim warning, a Conventions bullet and file-head notes; build on legion/INFRA-631 until sjawhar/legion#2422 merges; skills/legion-architect/SKILL.md unchanged.

implement: legion-worker: the push, PR body and proof rules (references/pr-body.md), conflicts-and-rewrites.md for the merge of legion/INFRA-631 and the base merge once sjawhar/legion#2422 lands
ce-simplify-code: the implementer's one simplify pass on the checker change, its tests and the .legion/INFRA-632 scripts before the final proof
test: legion-worker: the tester's proof rules (references/pr-body.md, 'What a proof is') for re-running the checker, difference check, rendered-text check, git merge-tree replay and CI read, each with a negative control
review: legion-worker: references/merge-gate.md and review-threads.md for the review, plus conflicts-and-rewrites.md to re-run restructure.ts --strict on the merge's main parent and compare bytes

findings.finding: The Commands fences pass acceptance 1 unchanged ('outside fenced code blocks') although the Outcome names a command as a list item that must merge clean; the checker skips fenced code.
findings.answer: D4 converts both fences into lists by rule; Acceptance 1 adds an awk check that exits 1 while any fence remains under '## Commands' (negative control on main's file); three AGENTS replay pairs are Commands pairs.

findings.finding: Fenced text becoming Markdown changes rendering (<tailnet>, <host>, <owner> stripped as HTML; LEGION_E2E_*_APP_* as emphasis; @biomejs/biome read as an @-include) and the word comparison has no defined normalisation.
findings.answer: D4 escaping rule (tokens with < > * | \ or a leading @ go in code spans); Acceptance 2 uses restructure.ts --report plus .legion/INFRA-632/check-differences.ts mapping every word-level hunk to one report entry, and a micromark+GFM rendered-text check that every old placeholder appears literally (negative controls named).

findings.finding: Criterion 2 allows only moves or pointers, but the design adds intro sentences, enumeration lead-ins, clause sub-items, head notes, the Conventions bullet, \| unescaping, the probe fence and lifecycle paragraphs.
findings.answer: Spec departure 1 lists each kind for the architect; each edit carries an id in --report so the difference check can match it.

findings.finding: Building on unmerged legion/INFRA-631 has traps: READY above-approved-head check, review range carrying +7224/-5835, squash-merge conflicts, concurrent edits to markVerbatim, squash body, stacking rules.
findings.answer: D1: merge of the sibling branch drops .legion/INFRA-631/ in the merge itself; review range is the delta from the merged 631 head; after #2422 merges the add/add conflict forces the base merge, take main's 631 paths and check an empty git diff origin/main over them; re-apply D9 if 631 changes markVerbatim; not stacked; the architect signs off only after #2422 merged. If #2422 merged before the implementer starts, start on main.

findings.finding: The replay criterion does not say per merge or per hunk; several pairs pass only if insertions move; kubernetes.md has 3 layout-caused merges; the append sentence contradicts INFRA-631's settled rule.
findings.answer: Acceptance 3 replays only each pair's layout-caused hunks, classifies each pair on the restructured base before merging, places insertions per the file-head note (spec v9 adopts 631's rule); kubernetes.md uses the 5 enumeration pairs (clean once lists) plus 3 controls; appends are two different places plus a same-place negative control.

findings.finding: The warning requirement describes a rule the tool no longer has (no close counted since 631 round 6); the warning would be silent in automated paths (stderr ignored, --write skips unchanged files at line 1150, restructure.ts hides stderr).
findings.answer: D9: warn at the first verbatim open naming the tag's own line, on stderr, exit code unchanged, printed before the unchanged-file shortcut; restructure.ts --strict fails on it; the guides test asserts empty stderr; CI unit tests in semantic-line-breaks.test.ts. Spec departure 2 records the trigger.

findings.finding: Criterion 1 covers lines the checker does not read (root AGENTS.md's closing blockquote holds two sentences).
findings.answer: D7 splits the blockquote by a named edit; Acceptance 1 adds the tester's independent sentence scan over every non-fence line including quotes, HTML blocks, setext headings and link definitions.

findings.finding: The e2e append point '## lib/free-port.sh' no longer exists and the design had no rule for new sections.
findings.answer: Spec departure 3; the e2e file-head note places a new section and its index item next to the script it is most like; section replays 9a8af2f1743e, ee9ec60b7930, 141989f72b63 are in Acceptance 3.

findings.finding: Citations constrain layout (reclaim_doc_test.go column-0 rules; in-file pointers like 'the paragraph after this list'); no link checker exists.
findings.answer: D6/D7 forbid splitting or sub-listing in the reclaim paragraph; pointer words are re-read and reworded where made false; Acceptance 2 diffs headings and in-file link counts and resolves cross-file anchors; Acceptance 4 runs the reclaim and heading-pinning Go tests and skills-guard.

findings.finding: Public names and the no-issue-key rule: .legion paths, replay notes, comments, test names, commit subjects.
findings.answer: D11: no key outside .legion/INFRA-632/ (Legion's ledger path, removed at retro) or in any commit subject; head notes, Conventions bullet, checker comments and test names carry none; check-private-names.sh passes; no changelog fragment (no package touched); retro learning named <slug>-pr<number>.md.

findings.finding: The Conventions bullet's scope ('a guide') is undefined and could clash with skills/AGENTS.md line budgets.
findings.answer: D7: files carrying the file-head note keep the layout; new guides are written this way; an existing guide adopts it only whole, except where its directory sets a line budget (skills/AGENTS.md).

findings.finding: Regeneration as main moves: anchored table conversion would fail --strict on every new table; split anchors drift; replay evidence vanishes at retro while INFRA-633 re-runs acceptance; the porting recipe's cases are unstated.
findings.answer: D2/D3/D4: Commands, tables and blank lines are rules (header-signature map with a generic fallback that warns); only rewrites and splits are anchored; replay patches linked at a commit SHA in the body; the porting recipe covers a command in the old fence, a new section, a new table, a warning, and a branch touching both 631's and this PR's files.

findings.finding: Root AGENTS.md may cross the 1,000-line review threshold.
findings.answer: Work step 4 measures wc -l at the structural commit; the body names the constraint (every session loads the file; the spec keeps its content reachable there) if it crosses 1,000.

findings.finding: skills/legion-architect/SKILL.md: name the one layout-caused merge, explain 11 vs 16, generated copy.
findings.answer: D8: not restructured; 1 of 16 merges layout-caused (458396560894); 11 counts Legion PRs' merges in the window, conf.txt every PR's; the claude-envoy copy does not change.

findings.finding: Stale or unsupported spec claims: 'never closes', 'no tracked file has such an element', the free-port heading, line numbers from c892b97d.
findings.answer: Departures 2 and 3; the body lists every tracked .md file the new warning names (reported, not changed); every edit anchors on text, not line numbers.

findings.finding: The citation survey missed memory_profile_test.go:147, which uploads scripts/e2e/README.md.
findings.answer: Recorded in the plan's readers list: it runs only with DISPATCH_EDIT_PROFILE_OUT set and asserts nothing about the text, so it needs no change.

specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 2: every difference between the old and new file is a move the plan names or a pointer to the new place.
specDepartures.plan: Also allows named format and rewrite differences, each with an id in restructure.ts --report: table header rows replaced by intro sentences and cells joined by ' — '; \| to | in code spans; the Commands fences, '#' separators and ```bash lines removed, commands and escaped tokens put in code spans; enumeration lead-in words; the probe command moved into a fence (its closing '.' dropped); clause sub-items; the five lifecycle lines as five paragraphs and the blockquote split; the file-head notes and the Conventions bullet; rewordings of pointers made false.
specDepartures.evidence: Converting tables, fenced commands and inline enumerations to lists cannot be done with moves alone (measurements 2-4 of plan.md); INFRA-631's architect accepted the same kinds for its guides (dispatch://INFRA-631, decision 2026-10-27 15:50Z).

acceptance: 2. Nothing is lost: every difference is a move the plan names, a pointer to the new place, or one of the named format and rewrite kinds listed in the plan, each matched by the difference check.

specDepartures.spec: The checker leaves the rest of a file unchecked after a verbatim element that never closes; warn naming the line where the unclosed element opens.
specDepartures.plan: Warn at the first verbatim open whether or not it closes, naming the tag's own line, on stderr with the exit code unchanged, in check mode and --write (also on an unchanged file).
specDepartures.evidence: Since INFRA-631 review round 6 (a09123df) the tool counts no close: markVerbatim (scripts/semantic-line-breaks.ts:548-570 at b9b2d0d0) freezes the first block holding an open tag and every line after it.

specDepartures.spec: scripts/e2e/README.md: new sections go before '## lib/free-port.sh'.
specDepartures.plan: That heading no longer exists (main has '## lib/held-port.py'); the file-head note places a new script's section and its index item next to the script it is most like.
specDepartures.evidence: grep '^## ' on main 690c0136's scripts/e2e/README.md: no lib/free-port.sh; the stage sections end at '## no-required-checks.sh' before '## lib/held-port.py'.
